args.description: 读取 roi-mapping skill 的 SKILL.md 文件
创建目录并执行 roi-mapping skill 的测试脚本
args.command:
mkdir -p /mnt/user-data/outputs/roi-mapping /mnt/user-data/workspace/roi-mapping
python - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib
tracks = {"tracks":[{"track_id":"track_0001","camera_id":"CAM_DEERFLOW_001","label":"person","last_bbox":[100,100,180,260],"confidence":0.9,"evidence_frame_ids":["frame_001"]}]}
p = pathlib.Path('/mnt/user-data/workspace/roi-mapping/tracks.json')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
json.dump(tracks, p.open('w'), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
PY
python /mnt/skills/custom/roi-mapping/scripts/run.py --tracks-json /mnt/user-data/workspace/roi-mapping/tracks.json --camera-id CAM_DEERFLOW_001 --position-strategy bbox_overlap --config /mnt/skills/custom/configs/deerflow_config.json --output /mnt/user-data/outputs/roi-mapping/result.json
